doc_title: An outside read on your AI build, for Louisville Brands

overview.label: Overview
headline: You asked where you are on the arc of your AI build.
This is a two-week outside read that answers it.
lede: You named the risk yourself: confirmation bias, recency bias, the fox watching the henhouse.
An audit from outside the build checks your own hypotheses against your own scorecard, in your order.
It sits on top of what you run. It changes no system.

tiles.note: Fixed scope, one written page at the end
No retainer, no second phase unless you ask
Each with a kill line and a score-back date
